data.one_liner: iOS‑compatible plist serialization and deserialization library for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Converts supported Dart objects to XML or binary Apple property list format and back. Provides methods for reading and writing plist strings or binary data with iOS‑compatible accuracy.
use_when: You need to read or write Apple .plist files on any Flutter platform
Cross‑platform apps must exchange configuration or preferences with iOS/macOS services
avoid_when: Performance‑critical binary serialization beyond plist needs
You require custom object mapping or code‑generated models
strengths: Accurate XML and binary plist output matching iOS behavior
Supports both XML and binary formats, including NSKeyedArchiver UID constructs
weaknesses: Only handles basic plist types; no custom object support
Binary dict ordering may differ for multi‑entry dictionaries
